newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Telkom Q1 net rises to 399.0 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Telkom Q1 net rises to 399.0 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian telecommunications giant PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia said on Friday it posted a net profit of 399.0 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against 307.2 billion rupiah in the year-ago period.
Telkom said in a statement earnings per share in the first quarter of 1997 was 42.7 rupiah against 32.91 rupiah in the same period last year.

Telkom said total operating revenues rose 22.7 percent to 1.37 trillion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 due largely to an increase in the number of telephone lines in service and the corresponding increase usage of such lines.
As of March 31, Telkom had a total of 4.32 million lines in service, up 24.2 percent from 3.47 million lines as of March 31 in 1996.
During the first quarter of this year, Telkom added 132,665 lines in service against an addition of 185,288 in the same period of last year.
Telkom said total operating expense increased 10.0 percent to 771.5 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against 701.2 billion rupiah in the same period last year.
The rise in operating expense was largely due to depreciation costs which rose by 15.8 percent to 394.0 billion rupiah from 340.2 billion rupiah in the year-ago period, Telkom said.
Telkom said total assets rose to 18.14 trillion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against 15.89 trillion rupiah in the same period of last year.
(in billion rupiah unless earnings per share)
NOTE: The results were unaudited. PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia is also listed in New York and London.
